instruction: Create a project directory at /home/user/project with three subdirectories: 'src', 'tests', and 'docs'.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened terminal with Ctrl+Alt+T, ran 'cd /home/user && git clone https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding', waited for clone to complete, then verified with 'ls -la'. Completed in 23 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open terminal, navigate directories, execute shell commands (git clone, ls), wait for long-running processes
metadata.task_rationale: Tests directory creation via terminal, a simpler but related command-line task. Model demonstrated terminal proficiency in the original trajectory.
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating nested directories via terminal. Custom getter checks existence of each subdirectory. Metric provides partial credit (0.33 per directory).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks existence of each subdirectory (src, tests, docs) under /home/user/project using 'test -d' bash command, which accurately extracts the filesystem state needed to verify the instruction.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter: since expected.type='rule', the metric receives the rules dict directly and accesses expected.get('required_dirs', []) correctly.
Full instruction coverage: all three required subdirectories are verified. The parent directory /home/user/project is implicitly verified since subdirectories cannot exist without it.
Partial credit logic is sound: each directory contributes 1/3 of the score, allowing fair scoring if only some directories are created.
Data flow is correct: getter returns dict {subdir: bool} -> metric iterates required_dirs and checks result[subdir] -> returns proportional score.
